scope_and_limitations: Standard; Functionality & Data only (F01-F05). Single-person, non-sensitive browser-local tasks. Chrome aborted and loopback binding is denied. Executed Node VM uses controlled DOM/storage/timer adapters: real application source execution, not browser observations. No real browser refresh/reopen, native validation, rendered feedback or click interaction verified. F06 deferred at Advanced and concurrent-tab edits explicitly excluded by README; U/A/S/P/O excluded. Python dependency installation blocked by network; engine select/template and report validation unavailable (see tooling.json and validation.json). UTF-16 length convention preserved from existing JavaScript/HTML; no new Unicode policy inferred.

evidence.description: Agreed product contract and excluded retention/concurrency boundaries.
Executed application source in Node VM; exact input cases, expected/actual readbacks and failure results. Adapters explicitly identified; no browser assurance.
Actual browser/server and audit-engine capability failures.
Inspected target source; hash in execution artifact.
27 executed handler checks including original cases, existing data, malformed storage, repeated edits, overlapping add/save, and failed draft preservation across another add.
evidence.environment: Node v24.19.0; controlled DOM, timers and storage adapters

findings.reason: Original reproduction and neighboring handler checks now pass in the Node adapter harness. Actual browser operation, native input behavior and promised browser retention transitions still require execution; no full criterion pass claimed.
findings.requirement_or_goal: README tasks 1-2: add titled task; save note and completion with independently readable values.
findings.affected_users_and_conditions: Single user adding, saving or reopening replaceable local tasks; controlled disposable test data only.
findings.change_scope_cost_risk: Small app.js correction within authorized tracker/: load existing records, commit edits, reject invalid notes, guard pending operations. Preserve browser-local architecture and valid data. Regression risk: startup parsing and asynchronous operation interaction; tested with adapters, browser recheck pending.
findings.verification_plan: Run tools/regression.cjs against baseline/current source; then execute browser add/edit/readback, refresh and close/reopen on one origin/profile, pending/failure and native boundary cases. See tools/regression.cjs for exact input cases.
